mild.name: Bleed
mild.description: You suffer 1 Health damage at the end of your Turn, and this damage increases by 1 additional Health per Turn while the condition persists (additional applications increase the current count by 1). You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect.

mild.name: Crippled
mild.description: Combat maneuvers and skills cost 1 extra Stamina. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect.

mild.name: Confused
mild.description: You have a 50% chance each Turn to target a random creature within range instead of their intended target. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Sense Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect.

mild.name: Dazed
mild.description: Moving causes immediate knock down and loss of Turn and Momentum. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect.

mild.name: Distracted
mild.description: Cannot use Focus. You can spend 2 Stamina to roll an Intellect Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect.

mild.name: Exposed
mild.description: Lowers Defense Dice by one size (d8 to d6, d6 to d4, etc.) cumulatively. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Sense Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect.

mild.name: Flanked
mild.description: Engaged by 2+ attackers within 2m, attackers’ Attack Dice increases by 1 size against you (negates any Cover bonuses you have). You can spend 2 Stamina to roll a Finesse Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect for this instance. Alternatively, automatically end if you move more than 2m away or allies engage the flanking enemies.

mild.name: Flinched
mild.description: Cannot use Reflex and lose Momentum. You can spend 2 Stamina to roll an Influence Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect.

mild.name: Hindered
mild.description: Lowers Action/Reaction Dice by one size (d8 to d6, d6 to d4, etc.) cumulatively. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality or Strength Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect.

mild.name: Impaired
mild.description: Lowers Attack Dice by one size (d8 to d6, d6 to d4, etc.) cumulatively. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality or Finesse Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect.

mild.name: Slowed
mild.description: Move 1 meter per Stamina used. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality, Finesse, or Strength Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect.

mild.name: Wet
mild.description: Reduces fire damage by half (round up), doubles shock and frost damage. You can spend 2 Stamina to roll a Finesse Action Dice vs Risk 4 to remove the effect. Alternatively, automatically recover near heat sources or in dry environments.

moderate.name: Blinded
moderate.description: Lose all Attack Dice bonuses and base dice decreases by 2 sizes. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Sense Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Burned
moderate.description: Your maximum Health drops by 5 cumulatively. Use appropriate Remedy to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Chilled
moderate.description: Your maximum Reflex drops by 1 cumulatively. Use appropriate Remedy to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Corrode
moderate.description: Lose 2 equipment Durability (attacker’s choice). Use a Repair Kit to restore Durability.

moderate.name: Deafened
moderate.description: Lose all Defense and Reaction Dice bonuses and base dice decreases by 2 sizes. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Sense Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Disabled
moderate.description: Cannot willingly attack. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality (if physical condition) or Influence (if mental condition) Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Dizzy
moderate.description: Whenever you spend Focus, double the amount spent. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Sense Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect. Alternatively, you can rest for 10 minutes out of combat to remove it.

moderate.name: Fatigued
moderate.description: Maximum stamina reduced to 2. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Frightened
moderate.description: Cannot willingly approach within 5m of the source of fear. Loses all Attack Dice bonuses and base Attack Dice decreases by 1 size while the source of fear is within line of sight. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll an Influence Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect. Alternatively, it automatically ends if you cannot see the source of fear for 2 consecutive Turns.

moderate.name: Immobilized
moderate.description: Cannot willingly move. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Strength or Finesse Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Poisoned
moderate.description: Your maximum Stamina drops by 1 cumulatively. Use appropriate Remedy to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Sapped
moderate.description: Your maximum Focus drops by 3 cumulatively. Use appropriate Remedy to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Silenced
moderate.description: Lose ability to speak. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality or Influence (if mental condition) Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Vulnerable
moderate.description: Take 200% damage determined by a specific damage type. You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality or Sense Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect.

moderate.name: Weakened
moderate.description: Halved melee and bow damage (round down). You can spend 3 Stamina to roll a Vitality Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect.

severe.name: Asleep
severe.description: Unconscious state that can be awakened with damage, Blinded, Deafened, Unaware while in this state. Any ally 1m beside you may shake/slap you for 1 Stamina to automatically wake you up, or spend 5 Focus to rouse without damage.

severe.name: Drained
severe.description: Immediately lose all Focus points. You can spend 5 Stamina to roll an Intellect or Influence Action Dice vs Risk 8 to remove the effect. Alternatively, you can rest for at least 1 hour to remove the effect.

severe.name: Exhausted
severe.description: Cannot regain Focus. You can spend 5 Stamina to roll a Vitality Action Dice vs Risk 8 to remove the effect. Alternatively, you can rest for at least 1 hour to remove the effect.

severe.name: Incapacitated
severe.description: Unable to act, attack, or defend for turns, attacks against you instantly hits and deals Critical Damage. Use appropriate Remedy to remove the effect.

severe.name: Knocked Down
severe.description: Prone, melee attackers do critical hit damage against downed targets, Slowed. You can spend 5 Stamina to roll a Strength or Finesse Action Dice vs Risk 6 to remove the effect. Alternatively, allies 1m beside you can spend 3 Stamina to hoist you up removing the effect immediately.

severe.name: Restrained
severe.description: Lowers all base dice by 2 sizes, cannot gesticulate. You can spend 5 Stamina to roll a Strength or Finesse Action Dice vs Risk 8 to remove the effect.

severe.name: Rot
severe.description: Your Injury raises by 1 cumulatively. Refer to your Director to determine the cost of your treatment.

severe.name: Staggered
severe.description: All attacks against you automatically hit for the next Turn or until your side regains Momentum. You can spend 5 Stamina to roll a Vitality or Sense Action Dice vs Risk 8 to remove the effect.

severe.name: Unaware
severe.description: Automatically takes Critical Damage when hit. You can spend 5 Stamina to roll a Sense Action Dice vs Risk 8 to remove the effect.

critical.name: Dying
critical.description: Reach 0 Health, lose 1d4 Health/round till -10 (dead). Must be Resuscitated.
